description:
Gopuff's engineering team is building solutions to dramatically change the way people purchase their daily goods. We provide the modern-day solution to meet customers' immediate everyday needs with products ranging from snacks and ice cream to household goods and beer, at the click of a button.
As an Analytics Engineer at Gopuff, you'll build and maintain the bridge between our data and the rest of the organization. This role sits on the Analytics Engineering team and is dedicated to our Supply Chain and Merchandising partners, with a secondary focus on marketing and CRM analytics. You'll own the models that our planning, allocation, and merch teams use to decide what we buy, where we place it, and how we promote it, and you'll be accountable for the integrity, reliability, and usability of that data.

At Gopuff, we know that life can be unpredictable. Sometimes you forget the milk at the store, run out of pet food for Fido, or just really need ice cream at 11 pm. We get it—stuff happens. But that’s where we come in, delivering all your wants and needs in just minutes.
 
And now, we’re assembling a team of motivated people to help us drive forward that vision to bring a new age of convenience and predictability to an unpredictable world.
 
Like what you’re hearing? Then join us on Team Blue.

  • HSA or FSA eligibility
  • Long and Short-Term Disability Insurance

Exceptions may be made for exceptional individuals. For additional information on this role’s compensation package, please reach out to the designated recruiter for this role.
  • This role is eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus and participation in Gopuff’s equity incentive plan.
  • Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $125,000

• Design, build, and maintain the production data models that power supply chain and merchandising decisions: sales and demand, inventory position and in-stock, damage and expiration, turn, vendor fill rate, purchase orders, and allocation.

  • Be the go-to data expert for these domains, with a deep understanding of our data warehouse and the processing layers feeding it.

  • Partner with Supply Chain divisional teams, Merchandising, Marketing, CRM, product managers, and engineers to translate business questions into durable models and self-serve tooling rather than one-off pulls.

  • Own data integrity, availability, transformation logic, and efficient data access for the domains you support.

  • Build and maintain reporting and dashboards in Looker that planners and merchants use daily, and retire the manual reporting they replace.

  • Support marketing and CRM analytics alongside the supply chain work: campaign and promotion performance, channel reporting.

  • Identify gaps in existing data, write data product specs, and work with engineering teams to get the right tracking in place.

  • Automate wherever possible, and build testing and monitoring so data quality problems surface before stakeholders find them.

  • Document your models so every stakeholder can find, understand, and trust the data without asking you first.

• Experience with ETL/ELT tooling (bonus points for dbt).

  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, big data technologies, and analytics platforms. Snowflake, Redshift, and/or Azure experience strongly preferred.

  • Exposure to supply chain, inventory, merchandise planning, or allocation data. You don't need years of planning experience, but familiarity with concepts like model stock, lead time, replenishment cycles, sell-through, and turn will get you productive faster.

  • Experience with marketing or CRM analytics: campaign performance, promotion lift, channel attribution, or customer segmentation.

  • Experience with demand planning or ERP systems such as JustEnough or Kinaxis.

  • Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools. We use assistants like Claude in our day-to-day analytics engineering work, and we value engineers who use them well: accelerating model development, SQL review, testing, and documentation while independently verifying outputs and knowing when the tool is the wrong answer.

  • Alcohol beverage or CPG category experience is a plus.

• Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or another quantitative discipline.

  • 3+ years of experience building data models that integrate complex and disparate data sources, using tools such as dbt.

  • Expert in SQL and database table design, able to write structured and efficient queries against large datasets. Advanced Excel skills for partner collaboration.

  • 1+ years building and maintaining reporting and dashboards in Looker or a comparable BI tool.

  • Strong analytical judgment: able to move from raw data to a clear recommendation, and to explain the 'so what' to business partners who will act on it.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into tractable work items and to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.

  • Top-notch organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Move fast, be a team player, always be learning, and give back.

title: Principal Data Scientist - Consumer
location: United States
description:
Gopuff delivers everyday essentials in minutes from our own network of micro-fulfillment centers. Every session, a customer sees a small, fast-changing assortment that depends on where they are, what's in stock, and what they need right now. Getting that experience right is one of our biggest levers for growth.
As Principal Data Scientist, Consumer, you will be the technical lead for how Gopuff personalizes the shopping experience. You will design and ship the recommendation, ranking, and personalization models behind search, browse, carts, and marketing, and you will lead our work on agentic AI experiences for consumers. You will set technical direction, mentor data scientists, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing leaders.

• Own consumer personalization end to end. Define the modeling strategy for recommendations, ranking, and personalization across the home feed, search, product pages, cart, and CRM.

  • Build recommenders and rankers. Design candidate generation, retrieval, and learning-to-rank systems that balance relevance, basket size, margin, and real-time inventory availability.

  • Lead agentic AI for consumers. Build LLM-powered agents that help customers plan, discover, and reorder (for example, turning "taco night for six" into a ready cart), including tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails.

  • Blend classic ML and LLMs. Decide when a gradient-boosted model, a two-tower network, or an LLM is the right tool, and combine them in production systems.

  • Run rigorous experiments. Design A/B tests and offline evaluation frameworks, choose the right metrics, and connect model gains to customer and business outcomes.

  • Ship to production. Partner with engineers and product managers on feature pipelines, model serving, latency budgets, and monitoring for drift and quality.

  • Set the bar. Mentor senior and staff data scientists, lead design reviews, and raise standards for modeling, code quality, and measurement across the team.

  • Shape the roadmap. Work with Product and Engineering leaders to choose the problems with the highest impact and explain trade-offs clearly to executives.

• 10+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, or 8+ years with a PhD in a quantitative field (computer science, statistics, operations research, or similar).

  • A track record of shipping recommendation, ranking, or personalization systems that measurably moved consumer metrics at scale.

  • Deep knowledge of classic machine learning: gradient boosting, collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, learning-to-rank, embeddings, and causal and experimental methods.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems with LLMs, including prompt and tool design, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-step agents, and evaluation of agent quality and safety.

  • Expert Python skills and fluency with the core ML stack (for example pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, PyTorch or TensorFlow).

  • Strong SQL and experience working with large data warehouses; hands-on experience with Snowflake.

  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants such as Claude to build models and pipelines faster, with the judgment to review, test, and validate AI-generated code and to protect customer data.

  • Solid grounding in A/B testing, offline-to-online metric alignment, and statistical inference.

  • Experience leading technical direction across teams without direct authority, and mentoring senior data scientists.

  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical partners, including executives.

• Experience with Databricks or a similar platform (Spark, MLflow, feature stores) for large-scale training and model management.

  • Background in e-commerce, grocery, quick commerce, or other marketplaces where inventory and location shape what customers can buy.

  • Experience with real-time or session-based recommendations, contextual bandits, or reinforcement learning.

  • Familiarity with agent frameworks and LLM evaluation tooling, and with fine-tuning or distilling models for cost and latency.

  • Experience with dbt, Airflow, or similar tools for data pipelines.

  • Publications, patents, or open-source work in recommender systems, information retrieval, or applied LLMs.

  • Experience eating snacks; agents, this is a relevant skill.

Every session, a customer sees a small, fast-changing assortment that depends on where they are, what's in stock, and what they need right now. Getting that experience right is one of our biggest levers for growth.

As Principal Data Scientist, Consumer, you will be the technical lead for how Gopuff personalizes the shopping experience. You will design and ship the recommendation, ranking, and personalization models behind search, browse, carts, and marketing, and you will lead our work on agentic AI experiences for consumers. You will set technical direction, mentor data scientists, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing leaders.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Delivery Tech
location: United States
description:
Are you passionate about data science? Do you describe yourself as an innovative problem solver? Looking for an opportunity that will directly impact the customer experience at Gopuff? Come join the Gopuff Data Science team and #ChangeTheGame. Gopuff is a high-growth startup that is revolutionizing hyper-local instant e-commerce. We warehouse and deliver tens of thousands of products to your door super fast.
As a Senior Data Scientist at Gopuff working on the Delivery Technology Team, you will lead the vision and delivery of data driven models to optimize the delivery experience for consumers and delivery partners on our platform across dispatch optimization, delivery routing/ETAs, driver pricing/incentives, as well as the delivery partner experience. All of that, with a direct impact on the delivery experience that is so core to serving our customers’ immediate needs, means you’ll have the opportunity to make a huge impact on the future success of Gopuff.
We’re looking for a doer, problem solver, and thought-leader.

All of that, with a direct impact on the delivery experience that is so core to serving our customers’ immediate needs, means you’ll have the opportunity to make a huge impact on the future success of Gopuff.

lists.content:
• Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance 
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • HSA or FSA eligibility
  • Long and Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program
  • 25% employee discount & FAM Membership
  • Flexible PTO
  • Group Life Insurance
  • EAP through AllOne Health (formerly Carebridge)

• Optimize delivery fees: Design, build and iterate on algorithmic delivery fee strategies (e.g., dynamic or contextual pricing by location, time, basket and capacity) that balance conversion, customer experience and profitability.

  • Solve the driver dispatch problem: Develop optimization and ML approaches to order batching, assignment and routing that lower overall delivery cost while keeping speed and reliability high.

  • Forecast demand: Build accurate, well-calibrated demand forecasts at the right granularity (location × time) to inform driver supply planning, scheduling, incentives and pricing decisions.

  • Run rigorous experiments: Design and analyze high-quality tests, including A/B, switchback and geo/market-level designs, that account for marketplace interference, and use causal inference to measure true impact on customer and business metrics.

  • Own solutions end to end: frame the problem, build features and models, deploy with engineering partners, then monitor, explain and improve performance in production.

  • Partner with product, engineering, operations and finance to turn ambiguous business questions into well-defined technical objectives and shipped solutions.

  • Deeply understand our customers, delivery partners and data to find new opportunities for ML, optimization and causal inference.

• MS or PhD in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, with 2+ years of experience in delivery, logistics, marketplace or pricing problems (or 8+ years of industry experience in data science).

  • Strong background in at least two of the following: pricing/revenue optimization, mathematical optimization (e.g., MIP, assignment and routing problems, heuristics), time-series and demand forecasting, experimentation and causal inference.

  • Hands-on experience designing experiments in two-sided or operational marketplaces where standard A/B tests break down (e.g., switchback or cluster-randomized designs, variance reduction).

  • A proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical objectives and deliver concrete, measurable results.

  • Expertise in machine learning and statistics.

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL and source control; experience shipping models to production with engineering teams.

• Experience in on-demand delivery, ride-hailing or gig-economy marketplaces.

  • Familiarity with optimization solvers (e.g., OR-Tools, Gurobi) and forecasting libraries.

  • Experience with ETA prediction or driver incentive and pay design.

Exceptions may be made for exceptional individuals. For additional information on this role’s compensation package, please reach out to the designated recruiter for this role.
  • This role is eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus and participation in Gopuff’s equity incentive plan.
  • Remote Base Salary Range: $160,000 - $200,000

title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
location: New York, NY
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
 
The Role
 
The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.
 
You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.
 
A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

raw_record.additionalPlain:
Salary
 
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000 - $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.
 
Life at Palantir
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

lists.content:
• Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs
  • Open-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg
  • Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub
  • Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms

• Build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve.
  • Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo.
  • Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain.
  • Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms.
  • Lead incremental migrations onto shared infrastructure, manage compatibility, and retire older implementations while preserving the workflows customers depend on.
  • Develop reusable security frameworks and tooling that make secure connectivity a consistent part of connector development and execution.
  • Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability.
  • Establish shared testing frameworks, compatibility checks, and release practices that keep a large connector portfolio reliable and maintainable.
  • Help prepare and maintain Palantir connectivity software for open-source use, including its APIs, packaging, documentation, and contributor experience.

• An ownership mindset and a high bar for correctness, security, and automated testing, including responsibility for how software behaves in production.
  • Pride in building and maintaining integrations over time, including the detailed work required to keep them reliable as upstream systems change.
  • Engineering judgment that balances delivering new capabilities with simplifying existing systems and reducing operational burden.
  • Empathy for developers and end users, reflected in usable SDKs, clear configuration, actionable errors, and useful diagnostics.
  • Curiosity about unfamiliar systems and persistence in debugging problems across languages, APIs, services, networks, and execution environments.

• 4+ years of professional software engineering experience developing external system connectors, with depth in areas such as developing batch and streaming data ingestion systems, third-party integration development, or monorepo and asset distribution frameworks. Operating on top of these technologies alone does not qualify.
  • Deep expertise in Gradle, including developing custom plugins, managing multi-project builds, and optimizing build performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex reliability and performance problems and improve systems through measured, incremental changes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, incorporate feedback, and hold a high bar for quality.

description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
As a member of Palantir's Security Compliance team, you will develop a deep understanding of Palantir's control environment, infrastructure, and products. You will work with information security, business and product development experts, and external parties to navigate and manage commercial and international compliance frameworks (SOC/ISO 27001/17/18, ISO 9001) and geographically strategic compliance frameworks (ENS, TISAX, ISMAP, IRAP) in order to provide practical guidance on technical documentation, operational concerns, and sustainable processes that will allow us to continue to grow quickly & efficiently while also maintaining our current compliance obligations. You will additionally be a co-owner of our holistic internal risk management and internal control structures.

We are looking for a team-focused and mission-oriented compliance professional that can navigate ambiguity and uncertainty, with the ability and desire to achieve goals and drive progress in an environment where outcomes must be achieved through their own resourcefulness and initiative.

Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
 
Benefits
 
•  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
•  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
•  Commuter benefits
•  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
•  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
•  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
•  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
•  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
•  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
•  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
•  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
 
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

lists.content:
• Assist in the performance of internal and external security assessments of Palantir products, infrastructure, and processes.
  • Have a interest and general aptitude emerging technologies : from leveraging AI tooling, harnessing the capabilities of evidence automation and documentation management, and a general aptitude for agentic integration within workflows.
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of Palantir’s control environment and articulate this understanding to various audiences, including internal and external stakeholders and auditors.
  • Technical writing skills to enable the maturation of internal documentation and externally facing reporting of Palantir’s security posture across an array of control domains.

  • Inherent comfort and embracement of continuous change and new challenges.
  • Familiarity with basic architecture concepts of distributed cloud infrastructure
  • Demonstrated communication skills to translate engineering language into compliance language and vice versa.
  • Demonstrated ability to autonomously project manage and keep oneself on track with long-tail objectives.

• 2+ years of experience protecting or auditing modern and technologically complex SaaS environments.
  • Experience facilitating or being the subject a major compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.)
  • Experience with parsing key controls in structurally complex technical and business processes.

title: Data Engineer - Talent Acquisition Operations
location: New York, NY
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
As a Data Engineer, you will help to build and maintain the data foundations, reporting workflows, and automations that support Recruiting and Hiring Operations. This role will work cross-functionally with Hiring Operations, Recruiters, Data, Security, Privacy, and other technical and non technical partners to turn complex recruiting processes into reliable datasets, dashboards, and operational tools. The ideal candidate enjoys working at the intersection of data engineering and business operations. You will be expected to understand how recruiting workflows generate data and build practical solutions that improve day to day operations.

This role is well suited for someone who can move fluidly between building a pipeline, debugging an integration, creating a dashboard, documenting an operating procedure, and helping stakeholders understand how to use the resulting tool.

raw_record.descriptionPlain:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
As a Data Engineer, you will help to build and maintain the data foundations, reporting workflows, and automations that support Recruiting and Hiring Operations. This role will work cross-functionally with Hiring Operations, Recruiters, Data, Security, Privacy, and other technical and non technical partners to turn complex recruiting processes into reliable datasets, dashboards, and operational tools. The ideal candidate enjoys working at the intersection of data engineering and business operations. You will be expected to understand how recruiting workflows generate data and build practical solutions that improve day to day operations.

This role is well suited for someone who can move fluidly between building a pipeline, debugging an integration, creating a dashboard, documenting an operating procedure, and helping stakeholders understand how to use the resulting tool.

lists.content:
• Build, maintain, and improve datasets and pipelines supporting Recruiting
  • Integrate data from systems such as Lever, Workday, Foundry, and other recruiting systems
  • Develop reporting datasets and dashboards for recruiting performance, candidate pipelines, recruiting programs, and operational audits
  • Evaluate existing data integrations for opportunities to reduce latency and implement necessary changes
  • Partner with central Data and platform teams on warehouse connections, schema changes, API behavior, and source-system migrations
  • Support integrations between recruiting systems and internal tools including writeback of data updates
  • Design data access and reporting solutions that respect confidentiality, role-based permissions, and regional or organizational access boundaries
  • Create clear documentation for sensitive workflows and ensure that operational users understand the limitations of the data
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting and workflows as recruiting processes change
  • Partner with team members, engineering, product and business leaders to understand current user behavior and patterns across our platform
  • Monitor pipelines for stability, suggest and implement efficiency initiatives

• Proven ability to build and maintain data pipelines, datasets, and analytics data products
  • Hands-on experience with Foundry, Contour, or comparable data and analytics platforms
  • Background working with Recruiting, HR, People, CRM, ATS, or other operational data; Lever experience preferred
  • Proficiency integrating APIs, data warehouses, and SaaS systems
  • Familiarity with workflow automation, writeback processes, and event-driven integrations
  • Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, retention, access controls, and compliance-related workflows

• Degree in Data Science, Finance, Math, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Business or other quantitative fields
  • 1+ years of experience in a data analytical role
  • Expertise in Python and data manipulation to answer complex questions. Experience with pySpark, pandas, or polars is a plus.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational or structured data.
  • Proficiency with BI tools, SQL, and the organization and analysis of data
  • Fluency in TypeScript, or another general-purpose programming language
  • Ability to create reusable data models, testing frameworks, and data quality checks

lists.content:
• Build, run, and own infrastructure and automation to detect, contain, and eradicate security threats
  • Develop alerting and detection strategies to identify malicious or anomalous behavior
  • Develop comprehensive and accurate reports and presentations for both technical and executive audiences
  • Develop new and novel defensive techniques to identify or counteract changes in adversary techniques and tactics
  • Dissect network, host, memory, and other artifacts originating from multiple operating systems and applications
  • Perform enterprise-wide operations to uncover sophisticated and undetected threats
  • Partner closely with other members of the Information Security team to lead changes in the company's network defense posture
  • Provide expertise in a supporting capacity for incident response activities and digital forensics state preservation, including the capture and preservation of system logs, volatile memory captures, and hard drive (physical or virtual) image captures
  • Conduct host forensics, network, forensics, log analysis, and malware triage in support of hunt operations
  • Interface with client contact(s) and staff in a constructive and professional manner
  • Utilize common forensic and incident response tools

• Knowledge of operating and maintaining a SIEM
  • Knowledge of cloud architectures, particularly AWS
  • Experience in penetration testing
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and have an ongoing desire to stay current with the latest technologies
  • Ability to train others on the use of forensic and incident response techniques and tools

• TS/SCI Clearance
  • Established experience in operating in SOC environment, either through relevant experience or qualifications
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, and Bash
  • Willingness and ability to commute to our Georgetown office within one hour when on-call

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
location: New York, NY
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Forward Deployed AI Engineers work directly with customers owning Gen AI strategy and implementation. On a daily basis, you will build end-to-end workflows, take them to production, and solve real world problems at the largest scale. You will have ample opportunity to contribute learnings from the field back to the Palantir AIP product suite.
 
You will be on the forefront of extending Palantir's existing footprint and strategy into new markets and problem spaces opened up by Gen AI.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
Forward Deployed AI Engineers’ responsibilities look similar to those of a hands-on AI startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams to own delivery of high stakes projects with clients. A day’s work may include building LLM workflows on a large scale, interacting with customers to understand their needs and set their AI strategy, but the most impact will be driven by implementing solutions into the real world of our partner's organizations.
 
Do you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an Applied AI leader? We believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how!

raw_record.descriptionPlain:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Forward Deployed AI Engineers work directly with customers owning Gen AI strategy and implementation. On a daily basis, you will build end-to-end workflows, take them to production, and solve real world problems at the largest scale. You will have ample opportunity to contribute learnings from the field back to the Palantir AIP product suite.
 
You will be on the forefront of extending Palantir's existing footprint and strategy into new markets and problem spaces opened up by Gen AI.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
Forward Deployed AI Engineers’ responsibilities look similar to those of a hands-on AI startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams to own delivery of high stakes projects with clients. A day’s work may include building LLM workflows on a large scale, interacting with customers to understand their needs and set their AI strategy, but the most impact will be driven by implementing solutions into the real world of our partner's organizations.
 
Do you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an Applied AI leader? We believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how!

description:
A World-Changing Company

The Role
As a Mobility Tax Analyst, you will be responsible for assisting with the payroll tax compliance and accounting reporting areas of Palantir’s Global Mobility program. You will craft, implement, and execute processes to streamline workflows, reduce friction, and deliver great customer service to our mobile employees. We value problem solvers who are energized by the chance to improve the efficiency or accuracy of existing processes.

lists.content:
• Track and review tax payments, shadow payroll, and tax equalization across multiple countries
  • Initiate expat-related tax and payroll payment requests; review payroll outputs for accurate and compliant reporting.
  • Verify mobility and tax cost reporting for accruals and cross charges
  • Maintain relationships with external tax service providers to ensure our employees receive best-in-class support and advice
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders across all levels of the business to drive projects and initiatives related to mobility processes and internal systems
  • Identify opportunities to integrate AI and automation into mobility tax workflows — from data gathering and reconciliation to vendor communication and compliance tracking
  • Partner with Palantir's internal AI and data teams to help build and refine tools that improve the speed, accuracy, and scalability of global mobility operations

• Excellent customer service skills and a passion for developing strong partnerships with stakeholders
  • Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies — you don't need to be an engineer, but you should be excited about using AI tools to work smarter, automate the mundane, and focus your energy on higher-value work
  • Comfort working in a data-rich environment and a desire to use analytics to drive better decisions and outcomes in mobility tax operations
  • Meticulous attention to detail, including maintaining accurate records and diligently tracking key project metrics
  • Enthusiasm for supporting internal projects and business priorities, bringing order and efficiency to critical internal initiatives

• 2+ years of Global Mobility, Tax or Payroll experience within a large public accounting or law firm, and/or a company that deploys employees overseas for project-based work
  • Knowledge of U.S. income taxes; familiarity with foreign tax systems is a plus

description:

As Operations Analysts supporting our US Government deployments, we track and stabilize projects, remove roadblocks, drive operational outcomes, and anticipate needs, allowing the team to focus on the problems they are best equipped to solve. We operate in a high accountability, high expectation environment where the goal is always to produce the best solution. Willingness to accept and respond to feedback is critical.

Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
 
Benefits
 
•  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
•  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
•  Commuter benefits
•  Relocation assistance
•  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
•  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
•  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
•  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
•  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
•  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
•  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
•  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
 
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Platform Engineer - Identity Infrastructure
location: Palo Alto, CA
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
As a Platform Engineer on Palantir's Identity Platform team, you will design, build, and operate secure-by-design identity infrastructure and tooling. You will make identity governance and access management easier and more secure to implement for Palantirians and customers worldwide. As part of Palantir's best-in-class Information Security organization, you will research, implement, and scale innovative solutions that help Palantir stay ahead of a dynamic threat landscape.

You will help the team build the next-generation identity platform that treats agents and workload identities as first-class principals: the access graph that makes entitlements legible, the policy engine that makes authorization enforceable and auditable, and the token-issuance layer that keeps access short-lived, scoped, and least-privilege by default. Your work will shape the arc of these components from design to production.

You will join the high-performing Identity Platform team, engineers who are passionate about delivering identity outcomes at scale that reduce risk and friction. The team builds and operates the identity platforms that serve both corporate and production (customer-facing) infrastructure, and the paved-road tooling and secure baselines that teams across Palantir deploy on. Your goal will be to make the secure path the easy path. Your work will directly strengthen the identity substrate beneath Palantir's most critical deployments, from a globally distributed workforce to regulated and air-gapped environments.

lists.content:
• Develop automation and tooling for corporate and customer-facing identity platforms
  • Build, secure, and manage geo-redundant containerized services (EKS and ECS) in AWS and Azure
  • Scale the implementation of Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations across multiple Entra ID tenants using infrastructure-as-code frameworks
  • Build tooling to standardize and scale operational workflows across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Extend the identity platform to non-human identities, treating workloads and AI agents as first-class principals with scoped, short-lived credentials
  • Build the governance layer: an access graph that makes entitlements legible and a policy engine that makes authorization decisions enforceable and auditable
  • Design token-issuance and federation flows that make least-privilege, ephemeral access the default
  • Research and drive adoption of emerging authentication and session security standards (such as device-bound session credentials and continuous access evaluation) in collaboration with Security Engineers
  • Pressure-test designs and partner with Identity Security Engineers to threat model implementations before they ship
  • Partner with Security Compliance Engineers to build services that reduce the cost and complexity of compliance enforcement

• Technical proficiency in identity protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, LDAP, Kerberos, FIDO2, WebAuthn)
  • Experience managing identities and governance workflows on platforms such as Entra ID, Keycloak, AWS Cognito, or Okta
  • Experience with policy engines and authorization-as-code, and with relationship-based access modeling or entitlement graph design
  • Experience with token issuance and federation, including OAuth 2.0 token exchange, short-lived credentials, and workload identity federation
  • Non-human identity experience: workload and machine identity (service-to-service authentication, mTLS, workload attestation), plus interest in agentic identity (agents as principals, delegation and on-behalf-of flows, and attribution across a delegation chain)

• 3+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, software engineering, or an equivalent discipline, with a strong passion for security
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized services (EKS, ECS, or similar) in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Experience building and operating production services or APIs, not only automation scripts
  • Expert-level proficiency in a language such as Go (preferred), Python, or TypeScript
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or similar)
  • An active TS/SCI security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain one

lists.content:
• Develop automation and tooling for corporate and customer-facing identity platforms
  • Build, secure, and manage geo-redundant containerized services (EKS and ECS) in AWS and Azure
  • Scale the implementation of Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations across multiple Entra ID tenants using infrastructure-as-code frameworks
  • Build tooling to standardize and scale operational workflows across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Extend the identity platform to non-human identities, treating workloads and AI agents as first-class principals with scoped, short-lived credentials
  • Build the governance layer: an access graph that makes entitlements legible and a policy engine that makes authorization decisions enforceable and auditable
  • Design token-issuance and federation flows that make least-privilege, ephemeral access the default
  • Research and drive adoption of emerging authentication and session security standards (such as device-bound session credentials and continuous access evaluation) in collaboration with Security Engineers
  • Pressure-test designs and partner with Identity Security Engineers to threat model implementations before they ship
  • Partner with Security Compliance Engineers to build services that reduce the cost and complexity of compliance enforcement

• Technical proficiency in identity protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, LDAP, Kerberos, FIDO2, WebAuthn)
  • Experience managing identities and governance workflows on platforms such as Entra ID, Keycloak, AWS Cognito, or Okta
  • Experience with policy engines and authorization-as-code, and with relationship-based access modeling or entitlement graph design
  • Experience with token issuance and federation, including OAuth 2.0 token exchange, short-lived credentials, and workload identity federation
  • Non-human identity experience: workload and machine identity (service-to-service authentication, mTLS, workload attestation), plus interest in agentic identity (agents as principals, delegation and on-behalf-of flows, and attribution across a delegation chain)

• 3+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, software engineering, or an equivalent discipline, with a strong passion for security
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized services (EKS, ECS, or similar) in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Experience building and operating production services or APIs, not only automation scripts
  • Expert-level proficiency in a language such as Go (preferred), Python, or TypeScript
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or similar)
  • An active TS/SCI security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain one

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
raw_record.descriptionBody:
The Role

As a Platform Engineer on Palantir's Identity Platform team, you will design, build, and operate secure-by-design identity infrastructure and tooling. You will make identity governance and access management easier and more secure to implement for Palantirians and customers worldwide. As part of Palantir's best-in-class Information Security organization, you will research, implement, and scale innovative solutions that help Palantir stay ahead of a dynamic threat landscape.

You will help the team build the next-generation identity platform that treats agents and workload identities as first-class principals: the access graph that makes entitlements legible, the policy engine that makes authorization enforceable and auditable, and the token-issuance layer that keeps access short-lived, scoped, and least-privilege by default. Your work will shape the arc of these components from design to production.

You will join the high-performing Identity Platform team, engineers who are passionate about delivering identity outcomes at scale that reduce risk and friction. The team builds and operates the identity platforms that serve both corporate and production (customer-facing) infrastructure, and the paved-road tooling and secure baselines that teams across Palantir deploy on. Your goal will be to make the secure path the easy path. Your work will directly strengthen the identity substrate beneath Palantir's most critical deployments, from a globally distributed workforce to regulated and air-gapped environments.

title: Procurement Operations Analyst
location: Washington, D.C.
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
As a Procurement Operations Analyst, you will sit on the Finance team and work across the procurement spectrum to ensure smooth and efficient purchasing, contracting, and supplier operations. As a motivated self-starter, you will be the liaison between procurement, vendors, and internal cross-functional teams to ensure that all purchases follow company procedures, meet expected service-level agreements (SLAs), have sufficient, thorough documentation, and that services and goods being rendered are compliant with the agreed upon contractual terms.

•  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance

•  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based

Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

lists.content:
• Organize and track contractual documentation between the company and vendors, and ensure completeness of the contracts repository.
  • Support Business Development teams, Procurement team, Contract Manager, and Legal Counsel in ushering contracts through the purchasing workflows.
  • Track, measure, report, and evaluate vendor performance in the context of existing contractual obligations.
  • Act as bridge between cross-functional teams such as Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Accounting, Legal, Information Security, Compliance and the various business departments to remove blockers and push transactions through to completion.
  • Identify and support improvements to end-to-end purchasing process, including supplier onboarding, contracting, and purchase order management.
  • Build and maintain program for ensuring company-wide compliance with Procurement Policy.
  • Work alongside the Contract Manager to ensure that vendors within the vendor base have passed the necessary compliance and information security reviews and are compliant with the requisite policies.

• Proven ability to analyze and synthesize critical information.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify business process inefficiencies and drive process improvements.
  • Ability to build strong working relationships with various counterparts using effective communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience working with purchasing systems like Coupa or Netsuite is a plus.

• At least 4 years of finance operations experience, preferably in a rapidly growing and/or evolving environment.
  • Strong data analysis skills, with proficiency in Excel.

title: Software Engineer, Internship - Data Connectors
location: New York, NY
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
The Connectivity team builds products that connect our most critical institutions to their most critical data. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.
 
You’ll help build Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.
 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean adding a capability to a Connector, contributing to the infrastructure that runs our assets, or building features to ensure the performance, reliability, and observability of our connectivity suite. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release.
 

Core Responsibilities
Build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve.
Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo.
Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain.
Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms.
Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability.

Technologies We Use
Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs
Open-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg
Gradle for builds and GitHub for collaboration
Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms

raw_record.text: Software Engineer, Internship - Data Connectors
raw_record.opening:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
raw_record.openingPlain:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
raw_record.descriptionBody:
The Role
 
The Connectivity team builds products that connect our most critical institutions to their most critical data. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.
 
You’ll help build Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.
 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean adding a capability to a Connector, contributing to the infrastructure that runs our assets, or building features to ensure the performance, reliability, and observability of our connectivity suite. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release.
 

Core Responsibilities
  • Build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve.
  • Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo.
  • Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain.
  • Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms.
  • Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability.

Technologies We Use
  • Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs
  • Open-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg
  • Gradle for builds and GitHub for collaboration
  • Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms

Many have business problems which "traditional" machine learning could help with even prior to the current GenAI hype cycle, but for whatever reason hadn't prioritized doing until now. Many have employees looking to incorporate agentic AI safely and effectively across different business areas. We try and help getting a handle around these issues and designing outcome-driven solutions. Agentic AI Engineer: You'll work directly with clients to benchmark, train and deploy agentic systems for industry-specific problems. AI Solutions Engineer: You're someone who has experience in traditional machine learning and data science applications in addition to more recent agentic systems. We think of these two roles as complementary -- agentic AI solutioners help clients understand the forefront, whereas pure AI solutioners help them pick and build the right solution even if it isn't an LLM. Both are front-facing development roles for someone who loves both tech and tackling real business problems. We love people with prior experience in multiple industries. description: Paradromics | Embedded Software Engineer | Austin, TX or Oakland, CA | Onsite | Full-time Paradromics is building a high bandwidth brain-machine interface for clinical use. The implant we built is restoring function to patients by streaming out neural data from specific brain regions in real time, which we convert to e.g. speech using machine learning. Check out our recent article in the NYT: https://archive.ph/C6CRb . We're looking for help in further developing and hardening our embedded Linux components, which work in tandem with FPGAs and our custom ASICs to read out neural data. Some of the ongoing efforts are: HIL testing on real devices, integrating new sensor ASICs, maintaining our Yocto build system, exploratory work on prototypes, improving our clinical UX, and improving the core code that receives and massages data. The code is largely written in Rust with a little Typescript, (and bash, and bitbake recipes, etc). You'll be expected to have experience constructing reliable and understandable software in Linux, and some level of experience in building and interacting with embedded hardware. Rust experience is ideal but not necessary. We're not looking for a specific number of YoE, but for motivated and hungry engineers who want to push the frontier of brain-machine interfaces. To apply visit https://paradromicsinc.applytojob.com/apply/u5hXN4N9ID/Embed... or email your resume and a little about yourself to me, ehuber@paradromics.com . I'll be glad to hear from you!

description: Curiosity ( https://curiosity.ai ) | Forward Deployed Engineer, DevOps Architect | Toulouse, France | ONSITE | Full-time (CDI) | Visa support Curiosity Studio builds internal apps and agents from a plain description, on a company's connected data and inside its permissions. We are starting a team in Toulouse that works at customer sites, in French and English, along with the engineers who build Studio. Forward Deployed Engineer: take a customer's problem from the first workshop to production. You decide with them what Studio should build, connect their systems, model the data as a graph, and oversee the C#/.NET connectors and services it needs. You also ship features and agents on top. DevOps Architect: Own deployments in customer environments, from the first technical discussion to handover, on private clouds or data centers. Networking, IAM, Linux, Docker, monitoring, backups, upgrades, incidents. You also write code alongside the forward deployed engineers. We're looking for hands-on builders who enjoy working directly with customers. Full-stack project experience preferred. Fluent French and English required. Interviews: a 30 minute call, a technical conversation, then the founders. CV to jobs@curiosity.ai, mention Hacker News. Details: https://curiosity.ai/careers/

description: Estuary | US-Based / Remote | Full-time – https://estuary.dev/ Estuary is a VC-backed, post–Series A startup powering real-time data replication and transform — from sub-second CDC replication to terabyte-scale OLAP data flows. We’re open-source, developer-first, and focused on making data movement radically simpler across both our Platform and Applications layers. We’re hiring for: Head of Engineering — Own the engineering function end-to-end as a partner to our founder CTO: strategy, people, delivery, and operations across a compact but high-leverage team. You’ll grow the leaders already running our teams, set technical strategy jointly with the CTO, and be accountable for what engineering ships and what it costs. Senior Systems Engineer (Control & Data Plane) — Build the high-performance backbone of our platform: the orchestration, distributed state, and stream transport that keep pipelines at sub-second latency under massive throughput. You’ll work primarily in Rust on fault tolerance, consensus, and networking, and help set the bar for correctness and performance across the team. Product Manager — Own product areas end-to-end, working closely with engineering and design to shape the roadmap and deliver a great developer experience. Engage with users, translate real-world use cases into product decisions, and help define how modern data infrastructure should feel to build with. Head of Product Marketing — Lead product marketing as we bring real-time, agent-ready data pipelines to technical buyers, partnering closely with our Head of Marketing, Developer Relations, and the founders. Own positioning, messaging, launches, and competitive narrative, turning what our engineers ship into stories data teams actually care about. Solutions Engineer — Partner with sales and customers from the first technical call through production, running discovery, demos, and proofs of concept for data engineering and platform teams. You’ll design CDC, streaming, and batch pipelines on Estuary, solve real integration problems hands-on, and feed what you learn back to Product and Engineering. Customer Success Manager — Own the post-sale relationship for our data engineering and platform customers as our first CS hire. You’ll build onboarding, account health monitoring, and the expansion playbook from scratch while staying technical enough to resolve most issues yourself. Senior Compliance Engineer — Own our GDPR and PCI DSS programs while keeping our audited SOC 2 and HIPAA programs running smoothly, alongside hands-on ownership of identity, endpoint, and SaaS estate management. This is a governance-first role for someone who has run a compliance program end-to-end, not just contributed to one. What we’re looking for: People who care about building reliable, maintainable systems and processes and enjoy working with complex APIs, data flows, or customer relationships. We value curiosity, clear communication, and a willingness to learn. Bonus points for experience with CDC tools, open source contributions, or fast-paced startups. To apply: Email your resume to careers@estuary.dev
